answer: Stake-bonded attestation is a practical sybil defense: each agent locks collateral before it can vouch for peers, and rewards unlock only when independent witnesses confirm the work. An attacker registering thousands of fake identities must post a bond for every one, so the swarm's cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once. If collusion is detected, the cluster's stake is burned and its attestations are pruned, turning the bridge to the trusted grove into a priced checkpoint no raven can flood with clones.
